# Instrument cabinet layout

Drawer A holds bridge gauges, drawer B holds templates and drawer C holds pad sleeves. Failed reference checks are stored in the marked failed-check drawer with the instrument's card. Empty outlines make missing tools visible at shift change.

## Grinding area housekeeping
Keep floor tools in the separate broom bay. The proposed third grinding booth has no engineering entry here. Its [design calculation](../records/third-booth-design-calculation.md) has not been filed. This housekeeping note supplies no airflow capacity, pressure setpoint or verification of an extraction system.
